key_insight: The study models a space-use photovoltaic array to compare operation with and without maximum power point tracking (MPPT) under varying irradiation.
engineering_relevance: The simulations inform power-management design for space solar arrays, while a microwave-transmission overview connects generation to potential Earth delivery.
method: Simulate a space-use PV array in MATLAB/Simulink.
Compare operation with and without MPPT across irradiation levels.
Review microwave transmission of space-generated solar power to Earth.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports selected comparative simulation results but provides no quantitative performance metrics or experimental validation.
watch_item: The abstract describes neither an AI method nor validation of an end-to-end space-to-Earth power link.
paper_title: Space Solar Applications: Simulation with MATLAB-Simulink Environment and Transmission of Solar Power Generated
